page.layout: One column of index entries, with page numbers at the right; the column is cut off at its right edge and the last line runs on in the next part. Running head at the top.; One column of index entries on the right, with page numbers at the line ends. The left part of the page is blank.

main_text.l: ventre praedita animalia omnia etiam vesicā habere. 136
vespertilio quib. prae caeteris auib. praedita. 126

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the page number after "Venus Ctesylla." is hard to read and may be 10 or 19. The first letters of several entries are heavily inked and read with some uncertainty, e.g. "ventre" and "veratri". The ligature in "Venetos" and "vesicam" is read as printed. The opening letter of "Q. Velius" is a decorated Q. The line "eunda,& ed quæ." is the start of an entry cut off from the previous part; it is kept as a fragment. The word "ed" and the number "215" are doubtful. The final word "quàm" stands alone at the lower right and is recorded as a catchword. The cut-off left part of the page is not described here.
